description: Disconnect a finding's SLACK_SYNC discussion block while preserving imported messages. Stops future synchronisation and may post a confirmation to Slack. Requires write permission and explicit user confirmation.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.

name: disconnect_finding_slack_thread
title: Disconnect a synced Slack thread
